release.notes: Firmware artefacts are produced by the firmware CI matrix (firmware/ci/build.yml) and attached to GitHub releases. Point base_url at your own release or a local directory when testing.

boards.name: Seeed SenseCAP T1000-E
boards.tagline: Credit-card GPS tracker for the mesh
boards.notes: Double-tap the side button to enter the Adafruit UF2 bootloader; the drive appears as T1000E.

boards.name: RAK WisBlock 4631 solar node
boards.tagline: Ridge-top repeater with months of autonomy
boards.notes: Flash with the Adafruit UF2 bootloader (double reset). For a bare RAK4631 without a UF2 bootloader use nrfutil or a J-Link — see docs/hardware/boards.md.

boards.name: Seeed SenseCAP Solar Node P1
boards.notes: Double reset to enter UF2 bootloader (drive SEEEDSOLAR).

boards.name: Heltec Wireless Tracker
boards.tagline: ESP32-S3 tracker with screen and WiFi
boards.notes: Flashing replaces the Heltec factory firmware. Hold BOOT while plugging in if the page cannot connect.
